openQuestions.q: The product scope is bounded to the roadmap doc plus optional verifier marker checks, but the current scope_contract_check fails on B-43de ProofStory lifecycle artifacts. Should those story-scoped ProofStory artifacts be added to the lifecycle artifact registry or scope contract, acknowledged as intentional provenance, or reverted until the contract permits them?
openQuestions.evidence: scope_contract_check --storyId=B-43de reports six unacknowledged OUT_OF_SCOPE violations for B-43de intent-collision, milestone-ledger, original-intent-snapshot, parent-ledger-rollup, proofstory, and slice-plan JSON; the plan and ProofStory contract require those artifacts for parent governance.
openQuestions.resolution: Resolved: B-43de product scope stays limited to the roadmap document plus an optional process-fact verifier marker. ProofStory lifecycle artifacts under .lattice/story/actives/B-43de are allowed only as CLI-generated gate evidence for this story, not as product/runtime implementation scope.
